# Travel

Travel planning is done under the following structure, which is what
APERtrail's folder settings default to:

```
Trips/
  Bookings/
Places/
  Countries/
  States/
  Cities/
  Accommodation/
  Food & Beverages/
  Landmarks/
  Locations/
  Photo Spots/
CRM/
  People/
  Companies/
```

All three modules sit at the vault root on a fresh install. Setting the
common parent folder in the settings tab moves all of them at once, and any
single folder can be repointed on its own.

See the respective template files, Company included: that folder is read
and written like the rest.
